text: 26 October, only one concept paper was deemed to be non-compliant and the remaining concept papers were sent to external reviewers, with individual WebEx sessions held, by Focus Area, with the reviewers to generate a formal recommendation, by Focus Area, for encouraging or discouraging the submission of Full Applications. Out of the 92 concept papers that were sent for external review, 57 papers were encouraged for Full Applications, with the respective totals by focus area as follows: • 12 in Foundry Operations • 8 in
